executive_summary: OFAC added 8 new entities and individuals to the SDN list under the SDGT program, primarily targeting individuals and entities in Lebanon, Syria, and Iraq. The additions highlight ongoing efforts to disrupt terrorist financing networks. The designations are likely to have significant implications for businesses and individuals operating in the region.
